notes.title: STEAM DECK Support
notes.content: Added support for the STEAM Deck.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: I double the gem/coin gain from all enemies and mining activities. Hopefully, this is something you wanted and will help lessen the grind. I also added two new buttons on the LEFT menu to disable VSYNC and enable alt timing. Most of you won't need to use these options but are included for those that have high Hz monitors.

notes.title: Harvey Hit The Superfluous
notes.content:
Some of you know I am a Houston dev. Well we did not escape the flooding and are in the process of tearing out sheet rock and work our butts off trying to get things cleaned up. My family is safe and dry. Hopefully my computers made it and I can get back to working soon. The code is stored on the cloud so I haven't lost anything in that regard. 

If you want to help post on social media and try to get someone to buy our game :)

- Adam Truncale

notes.title: Learn more about The Superfluous
notes.content:
The Superfluous Website

"The Superfluous" [soo-pur-floo-uh s] is cave-diving, sci-fi, rogue-lite, platformer with jet packs and lots of explosions. The game focuses on navigating an asteroid fighting enemies and collecting loot to level up your team of intrepid explorers. The Superfluous has a fun story and features a squad system that allows you to switch your squad members in and out when needed.

Other Features
- Couch co-op: bring a friend along and yell at them for getting your guys killed.
- 4 player local arena mode: take said friend and kill them for fun (in the game of course).
- Rogue Lite: when you die (which you will do) you won't lose all of your progress.
- Story: a fun story about the end of the world, bureaucracy, the military, and sci-fi culture.
- Controller Support

Available on PC, Mac, and Linux (tested on Ubuntu 16.04)

notes.title: New Update - Space Worms
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26570085/27e34b087c29bcdf85ea8f6bda2819dba5493030.png

A new update is live featuring SPACE WORMS!

You will start seeing smaller worms from level 5-14.

Level 15 has a surprise :)

The worms will split in a piece if broken in the middle. They are also very fast. There are a few weapons that are very effective against them (I'll let you figure that out). The screen will shake and you'll hear a crunching sound when they are close to the player.
